name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: One-Click Seamless Auto-Updater: downloads setup directly to %TEMP%, prompts confirmation, runs installer, and restarts silently without redirecting to browser
System Tray Double-Click: instant trigger for next 4K wallpaper download and live calendar HUD render
Wallpaper Categories Select-All Checkbox: master All checkbox dynamically checks/unchecks all 13 wallpaper themes
Immediate Apply Button: clicking Apply instantly regenerates wallpaper and updates dock settings in real-time
Dock Placement Options: choose between Top, Left, or Off
Signature Brand Footer: VladiMIR+AI opens GitHub profile; clicking version runs auto-update check
Accordion Font Chooser & Icon Sizing: expandable curated font panel with 12 fonts and separate folder/item sizes
